name: Forte Metals
verdict: Forte Metals saw zero paid activity across Meta and Google Ads in the last 28 days, making GBP the sole source of engagement with 81 total actions (5 calls, 37 directions, 39 web clicks). The biggest concern is a sharp 84.21% drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced profile visibility or a seasonal dip in local search demand.

performance.verdict: GBP collapse and 3 blocker SOW overruns demand immediate escalation, not ads action.
